verdict.rationale: Glama documents automations via schedules or webhooks (glama-docs-10), so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows version history, review or approval steps, or rollback for those automations. Building MCP server images from a GitHub repo and community mentions of uploading new MCP versions concern server hosting, not automations, and still show no rollback, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
